prompt: Implement a modular Enterprise Content Delivery Network (CDN) Edge Cache in C# with: (1) Edge Proxy Ingester parsing incoming media requests, (2) Cache Tier Manager implementing tiered RAM and NVMe SSD storage policies, and (3) Purge Controller handling instant cache invalidation webhook broadcasts.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Ingester Score: 0-5 (Evaluates request routing and proxying)
Module 2 Tier Score: 0-5 (Evaluates multi-level cache promotion/eviction)
Module 3 Purge Score: 0-5 (Evaluates instant invalidation broadcast handling)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates edge cache hit ratio and latency performance)
